content: Timoteo, be an-machi-guedgi an bega soged, Cristo-Jesús-bela-bela-anmargi-nued-binsasadgi be gatik ganguo.
Igi an dule-bukidarad-abargi emar-odurdake be an-itosa, deyob be dulemar-Bab-Igargi-nue-inniki-nanadimalad odurdakmogoed. Adi, amar nabir baigan-odurdakmarmogagar.
Be Jesucristoʼga-nued-arbaed-dulesoggu, naibi-itoged-abargi-be-gudiidi mer be bai itogo.
Dule sordaga-gubiele, geg dulemar-yogsaar-gudimalad-igarba akadii gued. Ar ade, e-dummad-sogedbarbi gudiguergebed, adi, e-dummad-yeer-ito imakegar.
Deginbali, dule-dodomalad bengunanair, dodoleged-igar-maidba-dasulir, geg emargi obined.
Dule-nainugi-arbaed, ibmar-gunbiele, bina arbagwelergebed.
An bega-ibmar-soged nue be itogo. Ar we an bega-ibmar-soged, Bab-Dummad magasaila-ito be-imakoed.
David-wagwa-Jesucristo be insao, burgwisgu, gannar durgusad. We-Gayaburba-Nuedgi an sunmakdiid.
We-Bab-Dummad-Gayaburbagi an sunmakdiid-ular, an naibid itosisunnad. Dule-isgana neg-ichodiidyob an esgoro-dubgi edilles siid. Ar Bab-Dummad-Gayaburbadi gwen galenaisulid, bur bule nasgumai gued.
Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-na-dulemar-susad-ular, an wiledisunnad, igi-barsaye an sogdisunnad, adi, amar nabir Cristo-Jesúsʼgi abonoleged-nikumarmogagar, degine, degisadegu eba wergudii gubaligar.
Ar we napira sogleged:

We-ibmar an bega Bab-Dummad-asabin-sogsiidi, dulemarga be nue sogmogo. Ega be sogo: Mer na be binsa abin-abin sunmakmaloye. Ar ade, we-ibmardi anmar-bendakosulid, ar igar nabiridsulid, binsa dulemar-baigan-be-itobukmalad-oichogedid.
Be-arbaedgi gatik nue arbanai be sae, adi, be nued-arbasadba Bab Dummad yeer be-dakegar. Be Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-napiragwad, nued dulemarga-odulogedba be-arbaedgi be bingegugwichi guosulid.
Galagwensuli binsa ee sunmaklemaladba mer be dao. Ar degi-sunmaklemalad bur bule isgumai dule-imaked.
Ar we-odurdaklegedi, boni dule-san-malemaiyob emar-imaked. Himeneo, degine, Filetoʼmala, dule-degimaladid.

Wemar, Bab-Jesús-Igar-Napiragwad-Maidgi bangudmalad. Wemar-ebogwad sogmalad, dulemar-gannar-durguleged-iba bato nasye. Degisoggu, wemala, gwenadgan-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-gwenna-gwenna-e-binsaed gadisundo.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad-Igar-Mesisaddi, geg gwaged. Ar weyob anmarga oyomaid:
Números 16:5 Degine, weyob oyomaibalid: “Bela dulemar-Cristoʼba-nanaimaladi, isguedgi banguergebed.”
Ar neg-dummagangi unnila or-nogbi, degi, mani-batebi niksulid. Suar-bate, degi, napa-bate nikabalid. Amar-bate gwenna-gwenna iba-gualirginbi ebuleged, baigandi bane-bane ebuleged.

Degisoggu, ar Bab-Dummadga ibmar-nuedga be gubiele, ibmar-isganagi be banguergebed, gwage-swilidik na be imakergebed. Geb degi, Bab-Dummadga ibmar-nuedga be gunonikoed, degi geb be, bela ibmar-nuegan imakega guagwar gudii guoed.

Ibmar-galagwensuli sapingana-oichomaladgi be banguo. Bur be dule-gwage-swilidikidgi-Bab-Dummadse-gordimaladba be we-igarmargi alamaknai guo: Igar-inniki-imaklegedgi, Jesúsʼgi-bensulidgi, sabguedgi, degi, ulubgi-bogidik-itogedba, be nanadii guo.
Mer binsa na galagwensuli-abin-abin-imakmalad be itogo, ar be wisid, we-degimalad urwedga guddaed.
Ar dule-Bab-Dummadga-arbaedi dulemar-baiganbo abin-abin-imaknai guedsulid. Bur dulemar-baigangi nued daergebed, nued emar-odurdakbalirgebed, deginbali, na san-bargaakwaar nanabalirgebed.
Degisoggu, be dule-begi-gwisgudimaladga binnalee sunmakoed, ar abakalegi Bab-Dummad a-dule-e-gwage ogwaalile, adi, a-dule igar-napiragwad amiarmogale,
degi, nabir nia-sailagi wakinnalile. Ar ade, a-dule nia-sogedba gudiid.
